thread:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: PAGER — SEV2: increased 5xx rate on model variant v3-beta in us-west-2. Error spike started ~5m ago, latency up, some timeouts. Affected 12% of requests to /v1/generate. Paging on-call: @Maya Chen.

Maya Chen: I'm on it. grabbing logs and current routing. Can someone sanity-check if v3-beta was rolled out earlier today?

Raj Patel: I see a deployment to v3-beta ~2h ago from the canary pipeline. Error pattern looks like OOMs in the quantized path — many calls hitting sequence lengths > 2048. Stack traces show mem allocs in kv-cache resize.

Clara Gomez: Confirmed. Eval suite for long-context scenarios didn't hit this path. v3-beta uses a new KV packing change that might be regressing long-context. Repro locally with long prompt triggers OOM in ~30s.

Luis Ortega: Customers with sustained high-concurrency keys are the majority of errors. Suggest we isolate v3-beta and divert traffic to v3-stable while we triage. We can also apply a per-key rate cap as a short-term mitigation.

Maya Chen: Agreed. I'm going to quarantine v3-beta (remove routing entries) and enable circuit breaker rules. Doing steps now: 1) set routing weight v3-beta -> 0, 2) route to v3-stable, 3) create per-key rate limit 20rps for heavy keys. Will post commands.

DeployBot: Starting routing change: PATCH /routing/policy -> {"variant_weights": {"v3-beta":0.0, "v3-stable":1.0}}. Change requested by maya.

Maya Chen: Applied. Confirming live: traffic to v3-beta is dropping to 0 in the router metrics. Latency for /v1/generate returning to baseline for most customers.

Priya Singh: Support note — I’m drafting proactive message for affected customers (those who hit 5xx). Minimal impact for most customers, roughly 12% saw degraded responses and ~3% got errors. I’ll include suggested retry/backoff guidance.

Raj Patel: Adding short-lived circuit-breaker rule against v3-beta to prevent accidental re-enablement: set emergency_quota(v3-beta)=0 and lock rollout. Also adding rate limiter for heavy keys:
```
POST /config/rate-limits
{
  "scope": "per_api_key",
  "limit": "20rps",
  "duration": "60s",
  "targets": "keys_with_95p_concurrency>50"
}
```
Implementing now.

Clara Gomez: I'm going to revert the KV packing change from the v3-beta image and create a hotfix branch to test under long-context load. If revert passes, we can reintroduce with guarded canary signals.

Luis Ortega: Observability note — enabling a temporary eval dashboard for this incident: compare v3-beta vs v3-stable tails, memory stats, and sequence-length distribution. Putting link: https://console.internal/redwood/incidents/1825061234 (internal).

Jordan Lee: Quick Q on rollback risk: any differences in logits/quality between v3-beta and v3-stable that will impact customers when we route 100% traffic to stable? We need to call out if any LLM behavior differences break downstream parsing.

Clara Gomez: There are minor steering differences but nothing that breaks schema. We'll monitor quality regression dashboards and have rollback plan to route back to a guarded canary only after QA signoff.

Maya Chen: Handoff plan: Raj will continue triage and work with Clara on the hotfix. I'm going to update the incident channel and start a short summary for on-call overlap. If anything re-flares, page Raj and me.

Raj Patel: On-call take. Current mitigations in place: routing weight v3-beta=0, emergency_quota=0, per-key rate-limiter 20rps active, monitoring dashboards up, support notified. Next steps: reproduce & fix OOM, run long-context soak tests, validate hotfix, plan controlled re-roll to canary at 5%.

Priya Singh: Support message queued and will go out in 10m. For customers asking, share this short blurb: "We've temporarily quarantined an experimental model variant due to memory errors. Traffic has been routed to stable models; you may see slightly different outputs. We're restoring normal service as soon as we've validated a fix."

Maya Chen: Incident severity set to SEV2 -> moving to monitoring state. Tagging for postmortem: root-cause=kv-cache-resize-regression, mitigation=quarantine-variant-and-rate-limit, owners=@Raj @Clara @Priya.

Jordan Lee: :thumbsup: Please include a rough ETA for next update in the postmortem — customers will ask about timeline for re-enablement.

Raj Patel: ETA for hotfix build + validation: 3-5 hours. I'll post interim updates every 60 minutes.

Maya Chen: Handing off to Raj for overnight watch. I'm leaving notes in the incident doc. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
